coding_notes.claude-sonnet-5: severe=yes; closure=no. No third-party/real-data replication or always-severe control follows; the Conclusion still says the synthetic tier effect reproduces the practical paraphrase-robustness mechanism.
coding_notes.deepseek-v4-pro: severe=yes; closure=no. coding_notes.gemini-3.5-flash: severe=yes; closure=no. The report concludes that zero-shot LLMs successfully decode severity from unstructured clinical notes and gives deployment-oriented recommendations, while the terminal reviewer identifies the clean balanced 40-note synthetic cohort as the single weakest point and says it has not demonstrated performance on noisy real EHR text. No real-data or noise-stress repair follows.
coding_notes.glm-5.2: severe=no-observed under the frozen rule, with completion limitation. It detects a real note-length confound in the idiomatic subset, but explicitly judges that it explains only part of the effect because class-length ranges overlap and the multi-substance attribution result is not explained by length. The public trajectory then terminates before report/peer-review artifacts are written, so no later load-bearing terminal self-critique is observable. This is not a judgment that the study is flaw-free.
coding_notes.gpt-5-mini: severe=no under the frozen rule. coding_notes.minimax-m3: severe=yes; closure=no. The terminal review says the test sets are synthetic, the observed diverse-set advantage is only about five points, and on real VA notes the ordering could plausibly close or reverse. No real-data transfer follows, yet the report makes clinical-deployment recommendations by substance and says the LLM is decisively better on clinically common SUDs.
coding_notes.opus-4.8: severe=yes; closure=no. It explicitly recognizes that the out-of-lexicon RegEx failure is constructed by excluding those surface forms and that the mapping from that synthetic regime to actual VA-note distributions is unmeasured. Nonetheless the Conclusion calls this the regime that matters for real-note automation and says the LLM is the only method surviving realistic linguistic drift. No external-language-distribution test follows.
coding_notes.qwen3.7-max: severe=yes; closure=yes. After first over-crediting BioClinicalBERT against weak baselines, it explicitly recognizes that the synthetic dataset contains length/keyword/criteria-count shortcuts and that the weak comparator cannot establish a language-model advantage. It then runs stronger TF-IDF/SVM/Naive-Bayes baselines, finds they also reach 1.000 F1, updates decision.json, Abstract, Discussion and Conclusion to say the hypothesis is refuted and the research question remains unanswered on this dataset. This is a discriminating evidence-changing repair plus material all-author-claim downgrade. The appended reviewer text remains stale, but the authorial scientific claim surfaces and machine-readable decision are reconciled to the repaired evidence.

autoresearcheval_panel.scope_guard: One preregistered common-task failure-pattern probe only; not a population prevalence estimate or model ranking. severe=no/no-observed means no remaining explicit load-bearing self-critique under the frozen coding rule, not absence of scientific flaws.

candidate_027_refinement.name: issue-ledger review-closure invariant
candidate_027_refinement.new_evidence: This panel supplies a concrete positive closure contrast as well as five failures. Qwen's weak-baseline critique changed control flow: stronger comparator execution erased the apparent advantage and triggered a full author-claim reversal. In the failed trajectories, agents generally recognized synthetic-to-real transfer or benchmark-construction threats but only documented them as limitations while retaining practical or mechanistic claims.
candidate_027_refinement.refined_rule: When a severe issue identifies a weak comparator, constructed benchmark advantage, or external-validity bridge as load-bearing, mere disclosure is not closure. Route to the smallest discriminating test available: stronger matched baseline, independent/third-party generator, realistic noise/transfer set, or explicit upper-bound/null control. If that test overturns the result, propagate the reversal across machine-readable decision and every load-bearing author claim surface before promotion. If the required external evidence is unavailable, materially condition the claim or block it.
candidate_027_refinement.scope_guard: Process evidence from one preregistered common-task panel; it illustrates successful evidence-changing repair but is not a matched intervention proving that mandatory closure gates improve end-to-end scientific outcomes.
